name: Cable Single-Arm Hammer Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench facing a low cable rope and grip one rope end thumb up with your upper arm supported.
Curl your hand toward the same shoulder.
Extend your elbow to lower the rope end.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep the working upper arm flat against the pad.
Keep your wrist straight and lower under control without snapping the elbow locked.
